judgments.reason: The phrase 'bilateral moderate diffuse bulbar conjunctival hyperemia' appears literally in the vignette and directly supports bilateral involvement as part of the diagnosis.

The phrase 'Each eye had an inferior symblepharon involving up to three clock hours and cicatrization of the caruncle.' appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports bilateral cicatricial conjunctivitis by documenting scarring changes in both eyes.

The phrase 'The inferior lacrimal punctum was scarred.' appears literally in the vignette; while it does not explicitly state bilaterality, it is consistent with the bilateral cicatricial process described and reasonably supports the bilateral modifier in context.
